howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: From zero to online in just a few days.
howItWorks.subtitle: You focus on your business. I handle every bit of the tech — from start to finish.

steps.title: We have a quick chat
steps.body: Tell me about your shop — what you sell, who your customers are, and what you want. No forms or jargon. A simple conversation on WhatsApp or a call is all it takes.

steps.title: I build your presence
steps.body: I create your website, set up your Google Business listing so you appear on Maps, and add smart tools like WhatsApp auto-replies — all customised for your shop.

steps.title: Customers start finding you
steps.body: Your shop is live and visible online 24/7. New customers discover you through Google and your website. I stay available for updates and support whenever you need.

services.label: Services
services.title: Everything your shop needs to grow online.

items.title: A real website for your shop
items.body: A clean, mobile-friendly site showing your products, services, location, timings, and contact details. Looks professional and works on every phone and computer.

items.title: Google Maps & Business listing
items.body: Get found when nearby customers search for what you sell. I set up your full Google Business profile with photos, hours, directions, and reviews — so you rank locally.

items.title: WhatsApp auto-reply bot
items.body: An AI-powered bot that instantly replies to customer messages even at midnight. Answers common questions, shares your menu or price list, and captures enquiries.

items.title: Product & menu showcase
items.body: A beautiful photo gallery or menu page so customers can browse what you offer before they visit or order. Great for food businesses, clothing shops, and service providers.

items.title: Simple AI automation for your daily tasks
items.body: Small, practical automations that save real time — like sending order confirmations, collecting customer feedback, notifying regulars about new offers, or auto-sorting enquiry messages. Nothing overwhelming. Just tools that genuinely make your workday easier.

about.label: About
about.title: One person, fully focused on your shop.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Ashish — the founder of Flowmatic. I started this because I kept seeing great local shops and vendors struggle to reach new customers, simply because they had no online presence.
A neighbourhood tailor with decades of skill. A street food stall with the best chaat in the area. A kirana store that every local family relies on. All invisible on Google.

I'm not a big agency. I'm one person who personally builds your website, sets up your Google listing, and makes sure everything works. You'll always talk directly to me — no middlemen, no support tickets, no runaround.
My mission is simple: take the same online tools that big brands use to reach customers, and bring them to every small shop and vendor in India.

values.title: Fully honest pricing
values.desc: No hidden fees, no confusing contracts. You know exactly what you get and what it costs before we start.

values.title: Built for real people
values.desc: Everything is simple to understand. You don't need to know anything about tech — that's my job.

values.title: Always directly reachable
values.desc: Message me on WhatsApp anytime. I reply personally and fix things fast — no waiting around.

about.founderHeading: Hey, I'm Ashish. I built this for shops like yours.
founderParagraphs: I saw that most small shop owners and vendors have no way to tell people online that they even exist — and that feels deeply unfair when they're running a genuinely good business.
So I decided to do something about it. I build websites and set up AI tools specifically for small, local businesses — at a price that actually makes sense for them.
If you have a shop and want more customers to discover you, let's have a quick chat. No pressure at all.

faq.q: How long does it take to go live?
faq.a: Most shops go live within 3–7 days from our first conversation. I handle everything — you just review and approve.

faq.q: Do I need to know anything about technology?
faq.a: Zero. You just tell me about your shop in plain language. I handle all the technical work.

faq.q: Can I update the website myself later?
faq.a: Yes — or I can do it for you with the Monthly Care plan. Small updates like changing prices or adding photos are included.

faq.q: What if I already have a Google listing?
faq.a: Even better — I'll optimise what you already have: add photos, fill in missing information, respond to reviews, and make sure it ranks.
None. The price I quote is what you pay. If you need hosting (usually ₹500–1,000/year), I'll tell you upfront.

faq.q: What types of businesses do you work with?
faq.a: Any small local business — kirana stores, salons, tiffin services, clothing shops, repair shops, street vendors, pharmacies, coaching classes, and more.
